title: AgenticFinBench: Benchmarking Financial Agents on Diverse Tasks from Real-World Requests
title_zh: AgenticFinBench：基于真实世界请求的多样化任务金融智能体基准

paragraphs.en: AgenticFinBench发布230项真实金融任务基准，提出无参考评估与幻觉审计框架，揭示智能体性能被夸大等问题。 Financial agents are becoming an important class of real-world AI systems. Financial tasks vary widely in type and difficulty, and many are open-ended with no ground-truth answers. However, existing benchmarks neither capture this breadth and open-endedness nor separate grounding from correctness. To bridge this gap, we introduce $\textbf{AgenticFinBench}$, a benchmark of 230 real-world financial tasks spanning 8 categories, 2 languages, and 4 complexity levels. We also propose a reference-free evaluation framework that combines question-specific rubrics with a two-stage claim audit that detects hallucinations, defined as claims absent from the agent's trace and refuted by external evidence. This framework better matches how financial work is assessed in practice. Experiments across 18 agent configurations reveal three key findings: (1) Ignoring hallucinations can overstate agent performance: hallucination auditing lowers the baseline leader's score by 7.58 points and moves it to fourth place. (2) Harness differences explain more variation in evidence grounding than model differences (28.6% vs 8.8%). (3) Quality scores fall from 89.44 on direct retrieval to 79.18 on the most complex tasks. Case studies show that agents struggle to explain how events affect company profits or stock prices, compare financial data on a consistent basis, and justify their conclusions. By releasing AgenticFinBench, we aim to advance financial reasoning, factual verification, and agent design for more reliable responses to diverse real-world financial requests. Our project page is at $\textbf{https://nashnovaresearch.github.io/AgenticFinBench/}$.
paragraphs.zh: AgenticFinBench发布了包含230项真实金融任务的基准，提出了无参考评估与幻觉审计框架，揭示了智能体性能被夸大等问题。金融智能体正在成为一类重要的现实世界AI系统。 金融任务在类型和难度上差异很大，其中许多是开放式的，没有标准答案。 然而，现有的基准既没有涵盖这种广度和开放性，也没有将事实依据与正确性区分开来。 为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 $\textbf{AgenticFinBench}$，这是一个包含230项真实金融任务的基准，涵盖8个类别、2种语言和4个复杂度级别。 我们还提出了一个无参考评估框架，该框架将针对具体问题的评分细则与两阶段声明审计相结合，以检测幻觉，幻觉被定义为智能体执行轨迹中不存在且被外部证据反驳的声明。 该框架更符合实践中金融工作的评估方式。 在18种智能体配置上的实验揭示了三个关键发现：(1) 忽视幻觉可能会夸大智能体性能：幻觉审计使基线领先者的分数降低了7.58分，使其降至第四名。 (2) 框架差异在证据依据方面解释的变异性大于模型差异（28.6% 对 8.8%）。 (3) 质量分数从直接检索任务的89.44分降至最复杂任务的79.18分。 案例研究表明，智能体难以解释事件如何影响公司利润或股价、在一致的基础上比较金融数据以及论证其结论。 通过发布AgenticFinBench，我们旨在推进金融推理、事实验证和智能体设计，以更可靠地响应多样的现实世界金融请求。 我们的项目页面位于 $\textbf{https://nashnovaresearch.github.io/AgenticFinBench/}$。
